value.rationale: The complete natural ell_p family is classified for exact finite-step proximal time-additivity, a property stronger than the general continuous semigroup limit. The nonsmooth infinity endpoint is exceptional alongside 1 and 2, while all interior non-Hilbert exponents fail with a computable signed h^2 defect. This distinguishes actual finite-step modeling from infinitely subdivided gradient flow and yields explicit diagnostic direction/scale, not merely a textbook nonexpansivity restatement.
